source.title: Silven - Heir of Glory
source.name: Silven
source.description: A Marksman with a strong sense of chivalry, skilled in using magic to control flying swords and manipulate gravity.

skills.name: Aloft Edge

description.raw: Silven summons 6 flying blades. For the next 8s, normal attacks will launch the summoned blades at enemies, with each blade dealing 70% (ATK-based) + 9% (SP-based) damage.
active: For the next 8s, normal attacks will launch the summoned blades at enemies, with each blade dealing 70% (ATK-based) + 9% (SP-based) damage.

skills.description_lite: Silven summons flying blades to attack enemies.

skills.name: Gravity Collapse

description.raw: When a flying blade sent by Silven's normal attacks hits an enemy, it leaves a Blademark. After performing 4 normal attacks, Silven's next normal attack turns into Gravity Collapse on the enemy with the most Blademarks. Gravity Collapse deals 200% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage, knocks the enemy down for 2s, and detonates all Blademarks on hat enemy to deal an extra 36% (ATK-based) + 3% (SP-based) damage. If Aloft Edge is active, increases the range of Gravity Collapse by 1 tile, and launches extra flying blades, dealing 48% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) damage 6 times.

skills.name: Tempered Field

description.raw: When a battle starts, Silven sets up a Tempered Field around himself, increasing his Ranged DEF by 48 while the field is active. Silven's flying blades sharpen when passing through the field, dealing extra true damage equal to 1.3% + 0.2% (SP-based) of the target's max HP, up to 14% (ATK-based) + 2% (SP-based). The field disappears if Silven moves, and will reappear after he stands still for 3s.

skills.name: Oath of Fealty

description.raw: When Silven receives a temporary stat buff from an ally, he immediately recovers 300 Energy and permanently gains 4 Penetration. He also permanently increases the ATK SPD of both himself and that ally by 16. This effect can only by triggered once per ally.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When up against powerful foes, Silven's knightly spirit kick in, allowing him to deal 25% more damage to enemies whose current HP ratio is higher than 50%.
